detail: Stage 2 executed with system candidates only: systemLNMO (base=library LNMO.json) skips the molecular funnel per the candidate-type table (ML potentials/xtb are not applied to whole-cell systems; screening responsibility shifts to Stage 3 simulation). Base determination is deterministic via the anchor table - plateau >= 4.1 V -> high-voltage LNMO (4.7 V-class cathode OCP; cell midpoint 4.17 vs NMC811 3.61) - and the discriminant was verified by parameter dump before running (lnmo_ocp numeric sweep: bulk plateau ~4.40-4.45 V; effective merged set = Chen2020 base + LNMO overrides, several newer-style override keys inert under installed pybamm 26.7.1, recorded honestly in entry 0). baselineChen2020 is the anchor-table default-system reference for the opening ceiling assessment (evidence for the material-bottleneck escalation), not a Stage 2 material candidate, hence excluded from funnel counts. No molecular candidates proposed this round, so no MLP/xtb elimination lines were exercised.
